tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh single second phase of cheek grooming for the attached exact adopted Iberian lynx. INPUT1 is sole identity, style, colour, markings, proportions and standing-body reference. INPUT2 is candidate phase A, used only for which forepaw moves and gesture continuity. Draw one complete same short upright character on genuinely transparent1254square canvas, same neutral head/torso/feet size and position. Preserve ear black tufts, asymmetric forehead/cheek/body spots, cream cheek ruffs/chest, three whisker-like cheek stripes and short spotted tail with brown tip on VIEWER RIGHT. Same warm brown outlines and painted paper, same plain white eyes and brown pupils, no highlights. The moving forepaw is VIEWER LEFT, same as input2. This same VIEWER-LEFT forepaw gently touches VIEWER-LEFT cheek and begins a tiny outward grooming stroke. Viewer-right arm stays down as neutral. Do not switch arms. Keep a single clean paw-face overlap, exactly two forearms and two planted feet, no extra thumbs/fingers, mirrored spots/tail, effects, text, labels, ground, shadows, props, tongue, paint bleeds or dirty colour lumps. Crisp clean native detail. Do not shorten torso or drop head, do not enlarge to fit.
